results.title: Chemical Management Managed Service
results.description_text: INTRODUCTION Battelle Energy Alliance, LLC (BEA), the Management and Operating Contractor of the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) owned Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is seeking Expressions of Interest from qualified vendors capable of providing a comprehensive Chemical Management Managed Service. INL utilizes an enterprise Chemical Inventory System (CIS) to manage the lifecycle of chemicals. The proposed managed service will operate and administer INL's CIS, ensure accurate inventory control, maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) governance, and coordinate sitewide chemical handling practices. CIS Administration & Data Governance: Maintain CIS data, container records, SDS library, hazard classifications, locations, and user permissions.

results.title: ADHESIVE
results.description_text: The vendor shall certify all items delivered under the resultant contract by the submission of both the safety data sheets (SDSs) and globally harmonized system (GHS) compliant product label, when applicable, to the contracting officer prior to delivery.
results.ai_summary:
Background
 The contract is issued by NAVSUP WSS (Naval Supply Systems Command Weapon Systems Support), which is responsible for providing supply chain management and logistics support for the U.S. Navy. The goal of this contract is to procure adhesive products that meet specific quality and safety standards for military applications.

Work Details
 The contractor is required to deliver adhesive products that meet the following specifications:

1. Manufacturer: Dow Corning Corp. (CAGE 71984) or acceptable alternate part number Instabond 1645 from Accrabond Inc. (CAGE 5V071).
2. Part Number: M4614621ATN.
3. Packaging: Items must be supplied in compliance with MIL-STD-129, including special marking for shelf life items, cure date, and expiration date.
4. Shelf Life: Minimum of 12 months remaining at the time of shipment, with at least 85% of shelf life remaining.
5. Delivery Schedule: Incremental deliveries of 100 tubes every 90 days after the first delivery, totaling four deliveries of 100 tubes each.
6. Quality Assurance: The contractor must maintain an inspection system acceptable to the Government and provide records of all inspections.

Period of Performance
 The first delivery is expected on or around April 17, 2024, with subsequent deliveries every 120 days thereafter.

Place of Performance
 Deliveries will be made to designated locations as specified by NAVSUP WSS.

Bidder Requirements
 Bidders must comply with specific requirements including:

1. Submission of Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and Globally Harmonized System (GHS) compliant product labels for any hazardous materials delivered under the contract.
2. Compliance with clauses regarding hazardous material identification and material safety data.
3. The contractor must not intentionally add mercury or mercury-containing compounds to any supplies under this contract.
